panels.title: Guests with NO backup
panels.description: Guests that no Proxmox backup job covers. Red = not protected.

panels.title: Shortest node uptime
panels.description: Orange = a node rebooted in the last 24h.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per Proxmox node. Load/core above 100% means work is waiting for CPU.

panels.title: Disk I/O per node (+ read / − write)
Storage usage
panels.description: Every Proxmox storage. Shared NAS storage (ugreen) is shown once.

targets.expr: max by (node, storage) (max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) * on (id) group_left(node, storage) max by (id, node, storage) (pve_storage_info) * on (id) group_left() (max by (id) (pve_storage_shared) == 0))

max by (storage) (max by (id) (pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) * on (id) group_left(storage) max by (id, node, storage) (pve_storage_info) * on (id) group_left() (max by (id) (pve_storage_shared) == 1))

panels.title: Storage details
panels.description: 'Full in' guesses from the growth of the last day. Empty = not growing.

panels.title: All guests
panels.description: RAM above 100% on a VM is normal-ish: Proxmox counts QEMU's own overhead.

targets.expr: max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_limit) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes / pve_memory_size_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_memory_size_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_uptime_seconds) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_not_backed_up_info) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})) or 0 * max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})
max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_onboot_status) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"}))

panels.title: Top 8 guests by CPU
panels.description: In CPU cores used (1 = one full core).

targets.expr: topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_cpu_usage_ratio * pve_cpu_usage_limit) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))
topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (pve_memory_usage_bytes) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))

topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (rate(pve_network_receive_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))

-topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (rate(pve_network_transmit_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))

topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (rate(pve_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))

-topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) (max by (id) (rate(pve_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) * on (id) group_left(name, node, type) max by (id, name, node, type) (pve_guest_info{template="0"})))
